question: The novel : 'A Prime Minister to Remember' was written by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Admiral Sushil Kumar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Admiral Sushil Kumar** is the author of the novel 'A Prime Minister to Remember'.
 
• The book offers an insight into the life and tenure of Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, providing a detailed account of his leadership and decisions.
 
• Admiral Sushil Kumar served as the Chief of the Naval Staff of the Indian Navy from 1998 to 2001.
 
• His tenure coincided with significant events in India's naval history, which are reflected in his writings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tavleen Singh** is a well-known Indian columnist, political reporter, and writer.
 
• **Arundhati Roy** is an acclaimed author, best known for her novel 'The God of Small Things', which won the Man Booker Prize for Fiction in 1997.
 
• **Bipin Chandra Pal** was an Indian nationalist, one of the prominent leaders of the Indian independence movement, and part of the Lal Bal Pal trio.
 
• 'A Prime Minister to Remember' is a significant contribution to Indian political literature, providing personal anecdotes and professional insights.
